events.title: Market Moe – Release Announcement
events.summary: The wait is almost over. Market Moe will officially launch on November 11! Step into a night-shift nightmare where the ordinary routine of a local Japanese convenience store shifts into something deep, dark, and psychological. What to Expect Atmospheric Psychological Horror: Experience the quiet, unsettling tension of an late-night Japanese environment. events.title: Demo Release Update
events.summary: We have decided to postpone the release of our demo to better prepare for an upcoming showcase. This additional time will allow us to polish the experience and present the demo in the best possible way. Thank you for your patience and for supporting the project by wishlisting the game. We can't wait to share the demo with you and will announce the new release date as soon as it's confirmed. Thank you for your continued support!
